instructions.original_snippets: Use rtk for shell commands when it is installed; bare commands are also fine.
Parallel tool calls: ALL independent calls in one message.
After EVERY AskUserQuestion call, check if answers are empty/blank; fall back to a numbered text list and wait.
NEVER load context from done/ without checking dates.
NEVER skip verifying the session_id after load.
NEVER proceed with assumptions when AskUserQuestion returns empty.
NEVER restore tasks from the context file as actionable work items.
NEVER omit the archive marker when reporting a done/-sourced file.
Present parsed data directly; no unnecessary synthesis.
When no context files exist, output the No context files found message.
--full reads the top 3 hot files, tasks and thinking artifacts in parallel.
